## 1. Packages and setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(gprofiler2)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(gplots)
library(cowplot)
library(BiocManager)
library(devtools)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/mnt/nfs/WORKSP/aminata.sow/LAB_DOCS")

```

## 2. Load data

```{r}
# combined expression matrix for all cells (GSE180759)
MS <- read.csv("../../tomas.gomes/processed.data/autoimm_scrna_TomasGuerreiro/Datasets/Multiple Sclerosis/GSE180759_expression_matrix.csv/GSE180759_expression_matrix.csv")

```

## 3. Create Seurat object

```{r}
# convert to a sparse matrix (stores only non-zero values) before building the Seurat object
MS_matrix <- as(MS, "sparseMatrix")

MS <- CreateSeuratObject(MS_matrix, project = "MS")
saveRDS(MS, file = "data/process/SeuratObjects/Multiple_Sclerosis/MS_raw.rds")
```

## 4. Quality control

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}

MS <- readRDS("data/process/SeuratObjects/Multiple_Sclerosis/MS_raw.rds")

MS[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(MS, pattern = "^MT-")
VlnPlot(MS, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, log = TRUE)

# QC thresholds
MS <- subset(MS, subset = nFeature_RNA > 300 & nFeature_RNA < 6000 & percent.mt < 15)

# check for remaining abnormal cells
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(MS, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(MS, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2

ElbowPlot(MS, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
```

## 5. Normalization, PCA and clustering resolutions

```{r}

MS <- NormalizeData(MS)
MS <- FindVariableFeatures(MS)
MS <- ScaleData(MS, vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), features = VariableFeatures(object = MS))
MS <- RunPCA(MS, features = VariableFeatures(object = MS))
MS <- RunUMAP(MS, dims = 1:30)

p <- DimPlot(MS, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
ggsave(filename = "output/Multiple_Sclerosis/MSUmap.png", plot = p, width = 12, height = 8)

# elbow plot to help pick the number of dims/neighbors for clustering
ElbowPlot(MS, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")

# scan a range of resolutions before picking one
MS <- FindNeighbors(MS, dims = 1:30)
for (res in seq(0.2, 1, by = 0.1)) {
  MS <- FindClusters(MS, resolution = res)
  colname <- paste0("res_", res)
  MS[[colname]] <- MS$seurat_clusters
}
res_cols <- grep("^res_", colnames(MS@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# save all resolutions to a single PDF for visual comparison
pdf("output/MS/All_resolutions_UMAP.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
for (res in res_cols) {
  p <- DimPlot(MS, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap") +
    ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
  print(p)
}
dev.off()

# resolution 0.3 was chosen for downstream clustering
p_res03 <- DimPlot(MS, group.by = "res_0.3", label = TRUE, reduction = "umap") +
  ggtitle("Resolution: 0.3") +
  NoLegend() +
  labs(x = "UMAP.h", y = "UMAP.h")
ggsave(filename = "output/MS/MSresolution.pdf", plot = p_res03, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

```

## 6. Clustering and marker genes

```{r}

MS <- FindNeighbors(MS, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
MS <- FindClusters(MS, resolution = 0.3)

# markers per cluster, used below to name the cell types
MS_markers <- FindAllMarkers(MS, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
MS_markers <- MS_markers %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)

```

## 7. Cell type annotation

```{r}
genes <- c(
  # CD4 T cells
  "CD4", "TCF7", "SELL", "CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC", # TRAC, CD3E, CD3D also expressed in CD8 T cells

  # CD8 T cells
  "CD8A", "CD8B", "GZMB",

  # B cells
  "MS4A1", "CD79A", "CD79B",

  # plasma cells
  "MZB1", "JCHAIN",

  # mon/mac
  "CD14", "CD36", "FCGR1A", "LYZ", "CD68", "CLEC9A", "CSF1R",

  # Microglia
  "P2RY12", "TMEM119", "CX3CR1",
  "SPP1", "GPNMB", "APOE", "ITGAX", "CST7",

  # Astrocytes
  "GFAP", "AQP4", "ALDH1L1", "SLC1A2", "C3",

  # Oligodendrocytes
  "MBP", "PLP1", "MOG", "MOBP", "MAL",

  # OPCs
  "PDGFRA", "CSPG4",

  # Endothelial
  "PECAM1", "VWF", "CLDN5",

  # Mural cells
  "PDGFRB", "RGS5",

  # Fibroblasts

  # Neurons

)
```

```{r}
# check expression of a few markers to see if subclustering is needed
FeaturePlot(MS, features = c("CD4", "TCF7", "SELL"), combine = F, order = T, reduction = "umap")

Idents(MS) <- MS$res_0.3
MS$seurat_clusters <- Idents(MS)

# clusters 11 and 19 contain mixed cell types
MS <- FindSubCluster(MS, cluster = c(11, 19), resolution = 0.1, graph.name = "RNA_snn")
table(MS$sub.cluster)

P <- DimPlot(MS,
  group.by = "sub.cluster",
  reduction = "umap",
  label = T,
  label.size = 5
) +
  labs(x = "UMAP.h", y = "UMAP.h")

ggsave(filename = "output/MS/MS_sub.cluster.pdf", plot = P, width = 12, height = 8)

```

```{r}

# major cell types
Idents(MS) <- "sub.cluster"
cluster_name <- c(
  "0" = "Oligodendrocytes",
  "1" = "Oligodendrocytes",
  "2" = "Oligodendrocytes",
  "3" = "Oligodendrocytes",
  "4" = "Oligodendrocytes",
  "5" = "Astrocytes",
  "6" = "Microglia",
  "7" = "Oligodendrocytes",
  "8" = "OPC",
  "9" = "Neurons",
  "10" = "Microglia",
  "11_0" = "Endothelial Cells",
  "11_1" = "CD4",
  "11_2" = "Mural Cells",
  "12" = "Astrocytes",
  "13" = "Astrocytes",
  "14" = "Neurons",
  "15" = "Astrocytes",
  "16" = "Astrocytes",
  "17" = "Microglia",
  "18" = "Fibroblasts",
  "19_0" = "Endothelial Cells",
  "19_1" = "CD8",
  "19_2" = "Mural Cells"
)
MS <- RenameIdents(MS, cluster_name)
MS$Major_Celltype <- Idents(MS)

celltype_cols <- c(
  "Oligodendrocytes"  = "aquamarine3",
  "Astrocytes"        = "#17BECF",
  "Microglia"         = "cadetblue",
  "OPC"               = "grey",
  "Neurons"           = "#4B2EFF",
  "CD8"               = "tomato",
  "Endothelial Cells" = "#E31A1C",
  "Mural Cells"       = "#1F78B4",
  "Fibroblasts"       = "cyan",
  "CD4"               = "olivedrab2"
)

# UMAP with a label placed at each cell type's centroid
umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(MS, "umap"))
umap_df$Major_Celltype <- MS$Major_Celltype
centers <- aggregate(
  cbind(umap_1, umap_2) ~ Major_Celltype,
  data = umap_df,
  FUN = median
)

library(ggrepel)
fig1a <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(umap_1, umap_2, color = Major_Celltype)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_cols) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = centers,
    aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, label = Major_Celltype),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    size = 6,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    label.size = 0.25,
    segment.color = NA
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(x = "UMAP.h", y = "UMAP.h")

ggsave(filename = "output/MS/MS_CellType.pdf", plot = fig1a, width = 12, height = 10)
```

## 8. Correlation between cell types

```{r}
Idents(MS) <- "Major_Celltype"
levels(Idents(MS))

# use highly variable genes to compute average expression per cell type
MS <- FindVariableFeatures(MS, nfeatures = 10000)
hvg <- VariableFeatures(MS)[1:5000]

av_expMS <- AverageExpression(
  MS,
  features = hvg,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data"
)$RNA

correlation_matrix <- cor(
  as.matrix(av_expMS),
  method = "spearman",
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)
correlation_matrix[is.na(correlation_matrix)] <- 0

pdf(
  file = "output/MS/MS_correlation.pdf",
  width = 12,
  height = 10
)
library(pheatmap)
colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100)
pheatmap(
  correlation_matrix,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  color = colors,
  fontsize_row = 9,
  fontsize_col = 9
)
dev.off()

```

## 10. TLS (tertiary lymphoid structure) marker heatmap

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# marker sets per functional group, from genes_TLS.csv
germinal_center <- c(
  "AID", "BCL6", "PAX5", "CD40LG", "AICDA", "MYC",
  "IRF8", "S1PR2", "ICOS", "CXCR4", "CXCR5"
)

inflammation <- c(
  "TNF", "IL1B", "IL6", "IL7", "IL8", "IL12", "IL17",
  "IFNG", "TGFB", "CCL2", "CCL3", "CCL4", "CCL5",
  "ICAM1", "VCAM1", "SELE"
)

lymphoid_chemokines <- c(
  "CXCL13", "CCL21", "CCL19", "CXCL12",
  "CXCR5", "CCR7", "CXCR4"
)

hev <- c(
  "NTAN1", "MADCAM1", "CHST4", "GLYCAM1", "FUT7", "CHST2",
  "MEOX2", "TSPAN7", "ANKRD43", "ZNF280C"
)

fdc <- c(
  "CD21", "CD23", "CR1", "CR2", "CD35", "FDCSP",
  "CXCL13", "CD54", "ICAM1", "FCER2"
)

markers <- unique(c(
  germinal_center, inflammation,
  lymphoid_chemokines, hev, fdc
))
markers <- markers[markers %in% rownames(MS)]

marker_groups <- case_when(
  markers %in% germinal_center ~ "Germinal Center",
  markers %in% inflammation ~ "Inflammation & Cytokines",
  markers %in% lymphoid_chemokines ~ "Lymphoid Chemokines",
  markers %in% hev ~ "HEV",
  markers %in% fdc ~ "FDC"
)
names(marker_groups) <- markers

group_cols <- c(
  "Germinal Center" = "#2166AC",
  "Inflammation & Cytokines" = "#D6604D",
  "Lymphoid Chemokines" = "#35978F",
  "HEV" = "#8073AC",
  "FDC" = "#E08214"
)

# percent of cells expressing each marker, per cell type
Idents(MS) <- "General"
DefaultAssay(MS) <- "RNA"
expr_mat <- GetAssayData(MS, layer = "data")

percent_mat <- sapply(levels(Idents(MS)), function(ct) {
  cells <- WhichCells(MS, idents = ct)
  Matrix::rowMeans(expr_mat[markers, cells, drop = FALSE] > 0) * 100
})
percent_mat <- as.matrix(percent_mat)

# average expression per marker, per cell type
avg_exp <- AverageExpression(
  MS,
  features = markers,
  assays = "RNA",
  layer = "data",
  return.seurat = FALSE
)$RNA

exp_mat <- as.matrix(avg_exp[markers, colnames(percent_mat)])
exp_mat[is.infinite(exp_mat)] <- NA

# drop markers with no expression in any cell type
keep <- rowSums(is.na(exp_mat)) < ncol(exp_mat)
exp_mat <- exp_mat[keep, ]
percent_mat <- percent_mat[keep, ]
marker_groups <- marker_groups[rownames(exp_mat)]

exp_mat[is.na(exp_mat)] <- 0
mode(exp_mat) <- "numeric"
exp_mat_scaled <- log1p(exp_mat)
exp_mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(exp_mat_scaled)))
exp_mat_scaled[is.na(exp_mat_scaled)] <- 0

q <- quantile(exp_mat_scaled, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95))
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(q, c("navy", "white", "firebrick"))

# bubble size = percent expressing, color = scaled expression
cell_fun <- function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
  grid::grid.circle(
    x = x, y = y,
    r = (percent_mat[i, j] / 100) * 0.45 * min(grid::unit.c(w, h)),
    gp = grid::gpar(fill = col_fun(exp_mat_scaled[i, j]), col = "black")
  )
}

celltypes <- colnames(exp_mat_scaled)
cols <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2")
)(length(celltypes))
names(cols) <- celltypes

column_ha <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  celltype = celltypes,
  col = list(celltype = cols),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

row_ha <- ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
  Group = marker_groups,
  col = list(Group = group_cols),
  annotation_width = unit(3, "mm"),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Group = list(
      title = "TLS genes",
      title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
      labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9)
    )
  )
)

ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  exp_mat_scaled,
  name = "Expression",
  col = col_fun,
  rect_gp = grid::gpar(type = "none"),
  cell_fun = cell_fun,
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
  column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  column_names_rot = 90,
  border = TRUE,
  top_annotation = column_ha,
  left_annotation = row_ha,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_split = marker_groups,
  row_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  row_gap = unit(2, "mm")
)

pdf("output/MS/TLS_markers.pdf", width = 8, height = 10)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()
```
